DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒を開く前に、宛名をご確認いただけますか。ご自身に届いたものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before opening the envelope, could you check the addressee? Was it sent to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あ、同居人の名前です。自分の通知だと思って持ってきてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分ではなく同居人宛ての封筒を持参したと気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oh, it is my housemate's name. I thought it was my notice and brought it.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Recognize that you brought an envelope addressed to your housemate rather than yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、その封筒はひとまずしまってください。ご自身の相談は何についてでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then please put that envelope away for now. What did you want to discuss for yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分に届いた税の通知で、どの期間の内容か読み取れず、説明を聞きたかったんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の税通知の対象期間が分からず説明を求めたかったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: A tax notice sent to me. I could not work out which period it covered and wanted an explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you wanted an explanation because you did not understand the period covered by your tax notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実物がないので、今日は通知の内容までは確認できません。通知の写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Without the actual notice, we cannot check its contents today. Do you have a photo of it?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真もありません。記憶で金額を言うと間違えそうなので、書類を取りに戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真がなく金額を記憶で伝えず実物を取りに戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: No photo either. I might give the wrong amount from memory, so I will go back to get the document.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have no photo and will fetch the actual document rather than give the amount from memory. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのほうが確認しやすいですね。戻られる前に、ご自身の宛名を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: That will make checking easier. Before returning, check that it is addressed to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の氏名と住所が合っているか確認し、封筒と中の通知をそろえて持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の氏名と住所を確認して封筒と通知をそろえると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check my name and address are correct and bring both the envelope and enclosed notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check your name and address and gather both envelope and notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談したい箇所に印を付けておくと伝えやすくなります。同居人の封筒はどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Marking the part you want to discuss will make it easier to explain. What will you do with your housemate's envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 開けずに本人に返します。自分の通知では対象期間の欄に印を付けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同居人の封筒は開けず返し自分の通知の対象期間に印を付ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will return it unopened to them. On my notice, I will mark the covered-period field.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return your housemate's envelope unopened and mark the period on your own notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご自身の書類で改めて確認しましょう。取りに戻る際もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us check again using your own documents. Take care going back to get them.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードへの追加をご希望ですか。今見ている数字は何の表示でしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to add money to your card? What does the number you are looking at represent?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この写真にある三百という数字が残高だと思います。次の移動に足りないので追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の三百を残高と思い次の移動に不足すると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think the three hundred in this photo is the balance. It is not enough for my next trip, so I want to add money.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you think three hundred in the photo is the balance and it is insufficient for your next trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真では数字の上の見出しが切れていますね。残高か利用額か、元の画面を見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The heading above the number is cut off in the photo. Can you view the original screen to see whether it is balance or amount used?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 元の写真を開きました。見出しは利用額でした。残高を読んでいたわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元写真の利用額という見出しを読み残高との取り違えを認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I opened the original photo. The heading says amount used. So I was not reading the balance.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the original photo's amount-used heading and acknowledge confusing it with the balance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず残高を確かめましょう。それと、次に使う区間はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: First let us check the balance. Also, which section will you travel on next?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日乗る区間のメモを持っています。このカードが使える区間か先に調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明日の区間メモを示してカードを使えるか先に調べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a note of tomorrow's route. I would like to check first whether this card can be used on that section.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your note of tomorrow's route and say you want to check card acceptance first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用案内で区間を照合しましょう。カードが使えるか不明なまま、追加するのは待ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us match the section against the usage guidance. Will you wait to add money while acceptance is unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。残高と利用区間の両方が分かるまで、追加の操作はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残高と利用可否の二点が判明するまで追加しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not add money until I know both the balance and whether I can use it on that section.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to add money until both balance and acceptance are known. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内で判断できなければ、乗る交通機関へ問い合わせましょう。別の支払い方法も確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: If the guidance does not clarify it, let us ask the transport operator. Would you also like to check other payment methods?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 問い合わせるときに、カードが使えない場合の支払い方法も聞いてメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交通機関への問合せでカード以外の支払い方法もメモすると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: When I ask, I will also ask and note how to pay if the card cannot be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will also note non-card payment methods when asking the transport operator. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、区間のメモを見ながら確認しましょう。明日の移動、気をつけて行ってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us check using your route note. Have a safe trip tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 家賃のお振込みについてですね。振込先の情報は何で受け取りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about transferring your rent, correct? How did you receive the recipient's bank details?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日のメッセージです。前と違う口座に送るよう書かれていて、契約書と一致しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 届いたメッセージの口座が契約書と異なると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: In yesterday's message. It says to send to a different account than before, which does not match my contract.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the account in the received message differs from the contract. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 銀行の窓口だけでは、その変更が貸主の指示か確認できません。普段の連絡先は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bank counter alone cannot confirm whether the change was instructed by your landlord. Do you know their usual contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書に電話番号があります。メッセージにある番号ではなく、そちらに電話して確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新しいメッセージ内ではなく契約書の電話番号に問い合わせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a phone number in the contract. I will call that one to check, rather than the number in the message.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will ask using the contract's phone number rather than the new message's number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認が取れるまでは手続きを進めないようにしましょう。メッセージには急ぐよう書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us not proceed until it is confirmed. Does the message say to hurry?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日中と書かれていますが、理由はありません。急いで送らず、変更の説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 理由のない今日中の要求に従って送らず変更の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says by the end of today, but gives no reason. I want to hear an explanation of the change rather than rush to send money.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not send money in response to an unexplained demand for today; ask for an explanation of the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 問い合わせの結果も控えてください。確認後に金額を決めるため、家賃の案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep a note of the inquiry result too. Do you have the rent notice so we can determine the amount after confirmation?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元の案内を持っています。確認できたら家賃と振込にかかる費用を分けて見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の案内を示して確認後に家賃と振込費用を分けて見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the original notice. Once confirmed, I would like to see the rent and transfer costs separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the original notice and ask to see rent and transfer costs separately after confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 費用は実際に利用する方法と条件を確かめてからご案内します。今日は振込を見送りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the costs after checking the method and conditions actually used. Will you hold off transferring today?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は送金しません。契約書の連絡先で変更を確かめ、案内と返答のメモをそろえて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は送金せず既存の連絡先で確認して案内と返答を持参すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not send money today. I will verify the change through the contact in the contract and consult you with the notice and my note of the reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not transfer today and will verify through the existing contact, then bring the notice and reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。確認できた情報でまたお話ししましょう。大切な書類をお忘れなく、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us speak again with confirmed information. Do not forget your important documents, and take care going home.

DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今朝は青い札の箱をこちらへ集めます。作業前に気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: This morning we will collect the blue-tagged boxes here. Any concerns before starting?

DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口に札のない箱が一つあります。青い札の箱と一緒に運んでもいいですか。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 行き先不明の箱を他の箱と一緒に運べるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is one untagged box at the entrance. May I carry it with the blue-tagged boxes?
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether you may carry a box with an unknown destination together with the others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行き先がわからないので、その箱は動かさずに確認します。どの辺りに置いてありますか。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Since its destination is unknown, we will check without moving it. Where exactly is it?

DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の右側です。ふたに赤い線があり、隣の箱とは印が違います。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 担当者が対象の箱を見分けられるようにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: To the right of the entrance. Its lid has a red line, a different mark from the neighboring box.
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Help the person responsible identify the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その印なら別の担当にも聞く必要があります。確認中は青い札の箱だけ数えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: With that mark, we also need to ask another person responsible. While we check, count only the blue-tagged boxes.

DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 数を記録する用紙はありますか。運び終わってからでは、数がわからなくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運搬前に箱の数を記録する方法を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is there a sheet to record the count? I may lose track after carrying them.
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check how to record the box count before moving them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この用紙に運ぶ前の数を書いてください。重くて一人で持てない箱は残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write the count before moving on this sheet. Leave any boxes too heavy to carry alone.

DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 奥の二箱は重そうです。一人で持たずに、応援をお願いしてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重い二箱を一人で持たずに扱う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: The two boxes at the back look heavy. May I ask for help rather than carry them alone?
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Handle the two heavy boxes without carrying them alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、私が応援を呼びます。札のない箱の周りも通れるようにしておきましょう。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I will call for help. Let us also keep a clear passage around the untagged box.

DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、青い札を確かめて数を記録し、軽い箱から運びます。入口の箱と重い二箱は残します。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 運ぶ箱と残す箱を区別して作業に移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will check the blue tags, record the count and start with the light boxes. I will leave the entrance box and the two heavy ones.
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish boxes to move from those to leave, then begin work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当がはっきりしましたね。私は入口の箱を確認してきますので、無理をせず作業を進めてください。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-EHM-UWAJIMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your assignment is clear now. I will check the entrance box; please proceed without overexerting yourself. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内を始める前に、今日の見学で特に知りたいことを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before we begin the tour, tell me what you particularly want to learn today.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 城の建物について学校で発表します。説明札を写真に撮って、後で読み直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明札を写真で記録したい理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will give a school presentation about the castle buildings. I want to photograph the information signs to read again later.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you want to record the information signs in photos. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発表の資料なのですね。撮影については、その場所の掲示を一緒に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: They are for your presentation, then. Let us check the photography notices for each location together.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 撮影の印が見当たりません。今は写真を撮らずに、確認できるまで待ったほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 掲示が見つからない場合の行動を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I cannot find a photography symbol. Should I wait without taking photos until permission is confirmed?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide what to do when you cannot find a notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうしましょう。私が確認している間、知りたい点を先に聞いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us do that. While I check, could you ask what you want to know first?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 建物の外観だけでは年代がわかりません。説明札のどの項目を読めばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 建物の年代を調べる手掛かりを得る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I cannot tell the building's age from its appearance alone. Which information-sign section should I read?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Get a clue for investigating the building's age. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 「建物の変遷」という見出しを探してみてください。難しい言葉は書き留めていただければ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Look for the heading History of the Building. Write down difficult words and I will explain them.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、年代とわからない言葉をノートに写します。通る方の邪魔にならない場所はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見学者の通行を妨げずに記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will copy the dates and unfamiliar words into my notebook. Where can I do that without obstructing passersby?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make records without obstructing other visitors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの端なら通路を空けられます。撮影の確認結果もそこへお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can keep the passage clear at this edge. I will tell you the photography-check result there too.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。端でメモを取りながら待ち、確認後に撮れる範囲だけ撮影します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影の確認を待ちながらノートを使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will wait at the edge while taking notes, then photograph only the permitted areas after confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use a notebook while waiting for photography confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料作りが進むといいですね。見学を終える際にも声をかけてください。それでは、ごゆっくりご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope your research goes well. Speak to me when you finish the visit too. Please take your time viewing.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は丸ごとの魚と切り身があります。どんな料理になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we have whole fish and fillets. What will you cook?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分を野菜と一緒に蒸したいのですが、鍋が小さいので切り身を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小さい鍋で蒸すための切り身を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to steam enough for two with vegetables, but my pot is small, so I am looking for fillets.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about fillets for steaming in a small pot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの切り身は少し大きめです。鍋の幅はどのくらいありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: These fillets are a little large. About how wide is your pot?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手のひら二つ分くらいです。大きな切り身を半分にしてもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鍋に入る大きさに魚を整えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: About two palm-widths. Could you cut a large fillet in half?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the fish to be prepared to fit your pot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、半分に切ってお渡しします。骨の扱いについても希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, we will cut it in half for you. Do you also have preferences about the bones?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 骨が苦手なので、目立つ骨を取り除いてほしいです。残ることもあるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 除去の希望と骨が残る可能性を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I dislike bones, so I would like the obvious ones removed. Please tell me whether some may remain too.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request bone removal and ask whether bones may remain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見える骨を取っても、小さな骨が残る可能性はあります。食べるときにも確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even after removing visible bones, small ones may remain. Check while eating too.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家までは寄り道せず帰ります。持ち帰る間に冷やせるよう、保冷の用意も相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 直接帰宅する間の持ち帰り方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will go straight home without stops. Could we also discuss keeping it cold on the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to take it straight home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保冷袋をお持ちなら入れ方を確認できます。保存については商品の表示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you have an insulated bag, we can check how to pack it. Also read the product's storage label.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋を持っています。表示を読んでから持ち帰り、調理するときにも骨を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持ち帰り後の扱いを自分の言葉で整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a bag. I will read the label before taking it home, and check for bones when cooking too.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize how you will handle it after taking it home in your own words. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは小さめに切って包みますね。お帰りの際は袋をしっかり閉じてください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will cut it smaller and wrap it. Close the bag securely when going home. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この展示には家の模型と間取り図があります。何を調べにいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This exhibit has a house model and floor plan. What have you come to research?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昔の家で台所がどこにあったか調べています。模型の屋根を外して見てもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 台所の位置を見るために屋根を外せるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am researching where kitchens were in old houses. May I remove the model's roof to look?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether you can remove the roof to see the kitchen location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示用の模型はそのままご覧ください。屋根を外した状態の写真をこちらで見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please view the exhibit model as it is. Here you can see a photo with the roof removed.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真で確認します。この黒く描かれた部分が台所なのか、図の読み方も教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 黒い部分が何を示すか理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will check the photo. Could you also teach me how to read the diagram, including whether this black part is the kitchen?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand what the black area represents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 黒い部分は柱の印です。まず凡例を見て、部屋の名前と記号を分けて読みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The black parts mark pillars. First read the legend, distinguishing room names from symbols.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 柱と部屋を取り違えていました。台所と隣の部屋の間には、戸があったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 台所と隣室のつながりを調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I confused pillars with rooms. Was there a door between the kitchen and the next room?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Investigate how the kitchen connects to the neighboring room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この図だけでは戸の形まではわかりません。横の解説に書かれている範囲を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: This diagram alone does not show the door's shape. Let us check what the explanation beside it actually says.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わからない部分は想像で描かず、解説で確認できたところだけ課題の図に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 推測を課題の図に混ぜない方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not draw unknown parts from imagination; I will include only what the explanation confirms in my assignment diagram.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not mix speculation into your assignment diagram. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: よい整理の仕方ですね。参照した展示の題名も一緒に記録しておくと見直しやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is a good way to organize it. Also recording the exhibit title you referred to will make later checking easier.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 展示の題名と凡例を控え、確認できない戸の形は空欄にします。資料を読んでから図を仕上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 展示の題名と凡例を控えて図を仕上げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the exhibit title and legend and leave the unconfirmed door shape blank. I will finish the diagram after reading the materials.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the exhibit title and legend and finish your diagram. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 疑問点を残しておくと次に調べやすくなります。写真の閲覧が終わったら画面を戻してくださいね。今日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keeping your questions will help your next research. Return the screen when you finish viewing the photo. Thank you for today.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運動用の靴をお探しですね。どちらで使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking for athletic shoes, correct? Where will you use them?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 体育館の運動教室で使います。指定の条件を書いた紙を持ってきたので、見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 体育館の教室が指定する靴の条件を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: At an exercise class in a gymnasium. I brought a sheet with the required conditions; could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the shoe requirements specified by the gym class. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拝見します。底の色などを指定されていますね。この候補を試して、足に合うか確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see. They specify things such as sole color. Try this candidate to check its fit.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: つま先は痛くありませんが、歩くとかかとが浮きます。もう少し小さいサイズを試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小さいサイズと比較したい希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My toes do not hurt, but my heels lift when I walk. I would like to try a slightly smaller size.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare with a smaller size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小さいものもお出しします。その前に、普段運動する際の靴下を履いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will bring a smaller pair too. First, are you wearing the socks you normally exercise in?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は薄い靴下でした。教室では厚めのものを使うので、それで試すほうがよさそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実際の運動時と同じ条件で試す必要に気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today I wore thin socks. At class I use thicker ones, so it would be better to try with those.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Recognize the need to try shoes under the same conditions as actual exercise. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件をそろえて比べましょう。厚めの靴下をお持ちなら履き替え、ひもも結び直してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us compare under matching conditions. If you have thicker socks, change into them and retie the laces too.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っている靴下に替えました。ひもを結ぶと浮きにくくなりましたが、両足で少し歩いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 履き替え後の靴の安定を両足で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I changed into the socks I brought. Tying the laces reduced the slipping, but may I walk a little wearing both shoes?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check shoe stability on both feet after changing socks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの試し履き用の場所でどうぞ。足先が当たる感じと、かかとの動きを両方見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Use this try-on area. Check both whether your toes touch and how your heels move.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 歩いても足先は当たらず、かかとも安定しています。このサイズを候補にして、紙の条件をもう一度確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: サイズを候補にして指定条件を再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: My toes do not touch even when walking, and my heels are stable. I will keep this size as an option and recheck the sheet's requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the size as a candidate and recheck the specified conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 足に合う候補が見つかりましたね。条件の確認が済んだらレジへお持ちください。教室を楽しんでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You found a candidate that fits. Once you have checked the requirements, bring it to the register. Enjoy your class.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 体験では一枚の作品を書きます。書いてみたい文字はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: In this experience, you will write one finished piece. Are there any characters you want to try?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の名前を書きたいです。ただ、筆を使ったことがないので、先に持ち方を教わりたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名前を書く前に筆の持ち方を学ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to write my name. But I have never used a brush, so I would like to learn how to hold it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Learn how to hold the brush before writing your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず握る位置と紙の置き方を確かめましょう。名前を書く前に、練習紙へ線を引いてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let us check the grip position and paper placement. Before your name, try drawing a line on practice paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 線の終わりに墨がたまってしまいました。筆に墨を付けすぎたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 筆に付けた墨の量を見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ink pooled at the end of the line. Did I put too much ink on the brush?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reconsider the amount of ink on the brush. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 少し多かったようですね。皿の縁で軽く整えてから、もう一本書いてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: It looks a little excessive. Lightly adjust it at the dish's rim, then try another line.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 墨の量を整えたら細い線になりました。でも、名前の曲がる部分で手が止まります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前の曲がる部分を重点的に練習する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: After adjusting the ink, the line became thin. But my hand stops at the curved part of my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Focus your practice on the curved part of your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その部分だけ大きく書いて、筆を動かす方向を練習しましょう。お手本を横に置きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write just that part large and practice the direction of the brush movement. I will put a model beside you.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 曲がる部分を練習してから、一枚に名前を通して書いてみます。失敗した紙はどこに置きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作品に進む順序とぬれた練習紙の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will practice the curve, then write my whole name on one sheet. Where should I put unsuccessful sheets?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the sequence before the final piece and how to handle wet practice paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ぬれた紙はこのトレーに広げてください。完成した紙も、重ねずに乾くまで待ちましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Spread wet paper on this tray. Let the finished sheet dry without stacking it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 練習紙はトレーに置き、作品は別に乾かします。名前が書けたら、片付け方も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙を分けて乾かし道具の片付けを教わる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put practice paper on the tray and dry my finished piece separately. Once I write my name, please also teach me how to put things away.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Dry papers separately and learn how to put away the tools. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 片付けも最後に一緒にやりましょう。今日は筆の動きがよくなりましたね。作品を乾かしてからお持ち帰りください。お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will tidy up together at the end. Your brush movement improved today. Let your piece dry before taking it home. Well done today.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は釉薬を掛ける前の準備をお願いします。こちらの見本を見て、気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today, please prepare for glazing. Looking at this sample, is there anything you are concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見本の縁と底で色が違って見えます。私が塗るときも、同じようになるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 縁と底の違いが自分の塗る工程にも現れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The rim and bottom of the sample look different in color. Will that happen in the stage when I apply it too?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the rim-bottom difference will also appear during your application process. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見本は焼いた後の状態なので、塗った時点の色とは違います。まず練習用の器で量を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sample is after firing, so its color differs from the color when applied. First, let us check the amount on a practice vessel.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 完成品の色だけで判断できないのですね。最初はどの道具を使って練習すればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 完成品の色と塗る時点の状態を区別して準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I cannot judge just by the finished piece's color. Which tool should I first use to practice?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the finished color from the application-stage condition when preparing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この筆を使います。器の表面のほこりを落としてから、私が示す部分へ少し塗ってみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Use this brush. Remove dust from the vessel's surface, then apply a little to the part I show you.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ほこりを落として塗りましたが、一か所に厚くたまってしまいました。続けずに見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作業を止めて職人の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I removed the dust and applied it, but it pooled thickly in one place. Could you check it before I continue?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop work and ask the craftsperson to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここで一度止めましょう。修正は私が行いますので、次の器では筆に含ませる量を減らしてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us stop here. I will correct it; on the next vessel, try reducing the amount held by the brush.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次は少なめに付けて試します。塗り終えた器を持つとき、塗った面に触れないほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次の器で量を減らし塗った面を避けて持つ方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Next time I will try less. When carrying a glazed vessel, should I avoid touching the applied surface?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reduce the amount on the next vessel and ask how to hold it while avoiding the applied surface. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、持ち方はここで実演します。置き場所も確認してから動かし、乾いたかどうかは私に聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I will demonstrate the grip here. Check its destination before moving it, and ask me whether it is dry.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち方を見てから指定の場所に移します。乾いたと自分で決めず、次の工程へ渡す前に声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実演を見て移し乾き具合を職人に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will watch the grip demonstration, then move it to the specified place. I will not decide it is dry myself; I will ask before handing it to the next stage.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Watch the demonstration, move the vessel and check dryness with the craftsperson. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順序で練習を進めましょう。私は隣にいますので、迷ったら筆を置いて呼んでください。それでは、作業に戻ります。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-UWAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us follow that practice sequence. I am next door, so put the brush down and call if unsure. I will return to work now. Thank you for your work.
